card.text: Explore Ijiraq, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Ijiraq’s shallow light curve gives a small lower limit on equatorial elongation. Its unknown polar depth and orientation are represented by explicit assumptions. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.08:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
